matt: Quick sync — I want to propose a 'strangler lattice' approach for carving domain contracts over the next 3 sprints. Goal: gradual extraction of thin facades per capability, preserve existing surface, and route by contract+version. Thoughts on major risks?
leah: +1 on gradual. main concern is backward compatibility for tenant routing and rate limits. who owns quota semantics during cutover?
jihoon: Agree. We should enumerate ownership for: routing, caching (KV prefix ownership), quota calc, and telemetry enrichment. If we don't lock those down we get weird double counting.
cara: From infra POV, we need a clear canary policy. Suggest per-tenant canaries (small %), and automatic rollback if p50 latency regresses by >20ms or error rate >0.5%.
matt: suggested division: routing and quota stay in gateway until facade stable; facade owns enrichment + model-proxying. Then flip routing once facade passes canary. That reduces blips.
leah: ok. how do we handle prefix KV cache ownership? two options: 1) shared cache with tenant-scoped keys + version tag, 2) temporary shadow writes to new cache and read-miss fallback to old. preference for shadow writes.
jihoon: shadow writes + tombstone migration sounds safest. we'll need a migration job to reconcile. add metric: % keys present in new cache per tenant.
cara: ops-bot can automate canary windows. example config for a proxy rule we'd want to deploy as a spike:```proxy:
  route: /v1/enrich
  target: enricher-service.v1
  fallback: enricher-compat.v0
  canary: 5%
  timeout: 300ms
```
matt: that config looks good. action items: (1) spike 1: implement facade + shadow KV for one low-traffic capability (enrichment) (2) define telemetry hooks and SLOs (3) write rollout playbook and migration job. volunteers?
leah: I'll own spike infra + canary automation.
jihoon: I'll do the migration job prototype and metrics.
cara: I'll draft the rollout playbook and SLOs, and wire alert thresholds into traces.
matt: great — I'll open RFC follow-up with the contract sketch and a small checklist. plan to start week after next.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary pipeline template created: pipeline/enrichment-canary v1. Use with role=architecture. :robot_face: 
matt: thanks all — keeping this thread for RFC link and any blockers, please drop short notes here. :thumbsup:
